headline: Ten lesser-known Indian dividend stocks offering high yields

modes.bear: High yields in lesser-known stocks can sometimes reflect cyclical earnings peaks or low liquidity risks.
modes.bull: High dividend yields up to 19.6 percent offer attractive regular cash flow potential for income-focused portfolios.
modes.simple: Some smaller companies pay out a large share of their profits as dividends. This list highlights ten of them for investors wanting regular income.

summary: Livemint has published a list of ten lesser-known dividend-paying stocks in India beyond mainstream names like Coal India and ONGC. These companies offer dividend yields reaching up to 19.6 percent, featuring firms such as Premco, GOCL, Accelya, and D-Link. Retail investors scanning the market for income-generating opportunities can use this curated list to research alternative dividend options outside the standard large-cap PSU space.
why_it_matters: New income ideas beyond standard PSU dividend favorites.
winners_losers: Income-seeking investors gain / standard choices unchallenged

hook: New automation partnership for GOCL Corporation

summary: GOCL Corporation Limited has announced a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with Blaze Automation, according to an exchange filing dated November 13, 2026. Retail investors should track future updates for clarity on how this partnership impacts GOCL's revenue and operational scope.

headline: GOCL Corp reports standalone net sales of Rs 4.11 crore for September 2026
hook: Sharp top-line growth at GOCL Corp
summary: GOCL Corporation reported standalone net sales of Rs 4.11 crore for the quarter ended September 2026, marking an increase of 84.95% compared to the same period previous year. Retail investors tracking small-cap performance can note the top-line expansion, though overall financial health requires examining net profit and operational margins alongside sales figures.
why_it_matters: Standalone quarterly revenue rises notably for GOCL Corp shareholders.

headline: GOCL Corp reports 85% growth in September quarter sales
hook: Revenue nearly doubles for GOCL Corp
summary: GOCL Corp reported consolidated net sales of Rs 4.11 crore for the quarter ending September. This figure represents a significant year-on-year increase of 84.95% compared to the same period last year. The company operates primarily in the energetics and commercial explosives sectors. While the percentage growth is high, the absolute revenue figure remains relatively small for a listed entity of this scale.
whats_next: Release of full quarterly net profit figures.
why_it_matters: Significant sales growth despite a small absolute revenue base.

headline: GOCL Corporation schedules NCLT-convened equity shareholders meeting
summary: GOCL Corporation Limited has issued a notice regarding an NCLT-convened meeting of its equity shareholders, scheduled to be held on November 24, 2026. This meeting is a procedural step typically associated with corporate restructuring, mergers, or schemes of arrangement. Shareholders on record will vote on the proposed corporate actions during this session. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review the NCLT notice details to understand how the proposed corporate action impacts their holdings.
why_it_matters: Shareholders vote on corporate restructuring proposals

headline: GOCL Corporation provides board meeting outcome regarding HNPCL merger
summary: GOCL Corporation Limited informed the stock exchange about the outcome of its board meeting held on October 19, 2026. The update specifically concerns the ongoing scheme of merger involving HNPCL and GOCL. Indian retail investors tracking corporate restructuring will note this incremental progress on the corporate action.
why_it_matters: Incremental progress on the GOCL-HNPCL corporate merger.
